text: My office receives frequent complaints regarding cars parking in the No Parking Anytime area on Brookers Lane at Lake Shore Boulevard West. To prevent motorists from stopping in this area, a No Stopping Anytime prohibition is recommended.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking machines on both sides of Brookers Lane, between Lake Shore Boulevard West and a point 15.0 metres west of Annie Craig Drive, in operation from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday, and 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. on Sundays for a maximum period of three hours, at a rate of $1.00 per hour. 2. Authorized parking machines on the south side of Brookers Lane, between a point 25 metres east of Lake Shore Boulevard West and a point 15.0 metres west of Annie Craig Drive to be in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday, and 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. on Sundays, for a maximum period of three hours at a rate of $1.00 per hour. 3.
